ValidationRule.description: New Install Ramp type requires Week Number, Run Frequency, and Run Duration.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Schedule_Type__c, "New Install Ramp"), OR( ISNULL(Week_Number__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Run_Frequency__c)), ISNULL(Run_Duration_Min__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: New Install Ramp schedule requires Week Number, Run Frequency, and Run Duration Min.
